Artist's Pixiv: https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/3560015

I understand that machine translations are nowhere near perfect, nor do I claim that.

However, after reading through this, I really felt like that this should be translated and shared. This is my first big translation project so I apologize for any obvious oversights.

I attempted my very best to assure that the translation is as close to the original as possible by cross referencing different translations (LLMs finetuned for Manga translations) for each panel.

Original is currently only available in Chinese on the artist's pixiv linked above.
